note: FIELD FORCE expiry rules and the REPORTS & ANALYTICS list reports. expiry_window_days: a DRA certificate or a bank authorisation whose end date is within this many days of today is 'due' (listed first); on or before today it is 'expired'. Each report below is a screen surface/screens/report-<key>.php rendered by surface/partials/list-report.php: the same Organization Setup filter (ALL first) and a CSV of exactly the rows shown. permission: the server-side gate for the screen and its CSV. month: the report takes a month picker. period: the report takes the full period picker (month / year / financial year / YTD / MTD / custom dates) and its rows are those inside the period. Every list report draws a bar chart of its counted columns and exports to Excel or CSV. groups: for headcount, which Organization Setup levels it can be broken down by (the first is the default). Money columns are read as exact decimals and never as floats. applicable_values: what pf_applicable / esi_applicable on an employee must hold (case-insensitively) to count as inside PF / ESI.
